page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8i.8xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance configured with 32 dedicated vCPUs and 128.0 GB of system memory. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8475B processor operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz on the x86_64 architecture, this instance utilizes the KVM hypervisor to deliver dedicated compute resources. The hardware configuration establishes a balanced 1:4 ratio of vCPUs to memory, allocating exactly 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for operating system and application data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 20 Gbps. The lack of integrated local storage and dedicated GPU hardware positions this instance as a cost-efficient option for workloads requiring stable, multi-core CPU performance and standard memory density without the overhead of specialized hardware. Appropriate workloads include enterprise web applications, medium-sized databases, containerized microservices, and general-purpose business logic processing.
